textbooks: Curiosity: Textbook of Science for Grade 8 (NCERT)
notes: Class 8 has no board examination; assessment is school-based. Chapters are those of the NCERT NCF 2023 textbook (2026-27 reprint) CBSE prescribes for the middle stage.
CBSE publishes no separate middle-stage syllabus; the textbook contents page is the source.
Topics are the section headings of each NCERT chapter (the book frames sections as questions).
